results.title: Databricks Launches Native Genie Plugins for Four AI Agents – Unite.AI
results.content:
Databricks had already connected Genie to outside assistants before this launch. A September 22, 2026 Genie One MCP announcement described governed context for assistants and coding agents over Model Context Protocol (MCP), a protocol for connecting AI agents to external tools. The new plugins add native interfaces within the named products while using the same context layer.

## How Genie Supplies Business Context [...] Databricks launched native Genie plugins on November 11, 2026, for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot. The integrations give all four agents governed access to business context held in Databricks, while other compatible agents can still connect through the Genie One MCP server. [...] Answer quality also depends on the data estate behind the ontology. Databricks’ September 1, 2026 implementation guide says Genie Ontology works on day one, but higher accuracy depends on clean data, consistent entity records, useful metadata, governed metric definitions, certified assets and continuing evaluation. It recommends beginning with one domain and strengthening its definitions, sources, governance and evaluation before expanding.

message.content:
## Recent developments
* **Always-on Autonomous Genie:** Databricks announced the second generation of Genie, transforming it into an always-on, autonomous agent for enterprise work that can manage goals, delegate to subagents, and track progress using the generally available Genie Ontology knowledge layer and Genie Search [1, 7].
* **Native AI Integrations:** Databricks launched native Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, and Grok Bot, providing these third-party agents with governed enterprise context, alongside its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support [6].
* **Massive International Investments:** Databricks committed approximately $3 billion across Europe and the Middle East over the next three years to scale enterprise AI adoption with Lakebase, Genie, and Unity Gateway, including a specific $500M+ investment in the Netherlands [1, 2].
* **Spreadsheet Integration & Strategic Wins:** The company acquired Row Zero to bring live, governed spreadsheets into Genie, and Fox Corporation selected Databricks as a strategic partner for its next-gen data and AI platform [1, 2].

## Talking points
* How is enterprise adoption tracking for the new always-on Genie and its native integrations with major AI models like ChatGPT and Claude [6]?
* What are the deployment priorities and timelines for the recently announced $3 billion investment rollout across Europe and the Middle East [2]?
* How does the general availability of Genie Ontology and Genie Search impact data governance and data cleanliness requirements for new customers [6, 7]?
* What is the current outlook on enterprise data estate readiness when moving from pilot domains to full-scale autonomous agent deployment [6]?

## Open questions
* How will the integration of Row Zero spreadsheets perform at scale within autonomous workflows inside Genie [1, 2]?
* What are the specific timelines or market conditions guiding Databricks' anticipated trajectory toward an IPO [4]?
